source.author: Wesley Ramos dos Santos
source.title: Predição de transtornos de saúde mental a partir de dados provenientes de redes sociais

metricDefinitions.macroF1Formula: arithmetic mean of controlF1 and anxietyF1
metricDefinitions.precisionRecall: P and R are described as model-average precision and recall; the aggregation convention is not stated

reportedMethod.bertInference: 50 sequências aleatórias de 10 posts consecutivos por usuário, combinadas por voto majoritário
reportedMethod.relevance: GPT-3.5 rotula uma amostra aleatória de 30.000 posts; T5 propaga os rótulos aos posts restantes
reportedMethod.mentionSignal: GPT.AltaBaixaMenções acrescenta um sinal não textual de menções Bag-of-Users

caveats: The thesis reports metrics rounded to two decimal places.
P and R are not directly comparable with the champion's anxiety-class precision and recall.
The point estimates are not a paired significance test because the thesis user-level predictions are unavailable.
The thesis and champion use different representation, relevance, temporal-window, and ensemble procedures.
